Package entry points: `retiam`.

items: DEFAULT_EXCALIDRAW_OPTIONS: Defaults that do not depend on a preset. Preset-dependent values (roughness, bowing, passes, overshoot, crossCorners) live in `EXCALIDRAW_PRESETS`.

seedFromEntityId: Hashes an entity ID deterministically into a positive 32-bit integer seed in [1, 1000000]. Uses MurmurHash3 / SplitMix32 integer finalizer for high-quality avalanche properties, guaranteeing distinct shapes have unique hand-drawn jitter while remaining 100% deterministic across runs.

Excalidraw: Hand-drawn whiteboard style (outline sketching plus hachure-style fills) for any vector entity. The generated fills are a snapshot of the geometry: after changing a shape's size or points, call `Excalidraw.apply(entity)` again to rebuild them.

items: seedFromEntityId: Implementation: `let h = (entityId + Math.imul(baseSeed >>> 0, 0x9e3779b9)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 0x85ebca6b); h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 0xc2b2ae35); return (((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) % 1000000) + 1;`.

items: ExcalidrawFillStyle: Hand-drawn fill patterns: - 'hachure': parallel diagonal lines (Excalidraw default). - 'cross-hatch': two crossing sets of diagonal lines. - 'grid': orthogonal grid of horizontal and vertical lines. - 'zigzag': one continuous back-and-forth stroke with rounded looping turns. - 'scribble': expressive marker scribble with energetic turns and organic hand wander. - 'dots': stippled dots. - 'sketch': dense two-angle pencil shading. - 'solid': tight zigzag scribble that fully covers the interior. - 'filled': clean solid color wash (no hatch lines) covering the interior. - 'none': no hand-drawn fill.
ExcalidrawOptions: Options for the Excalidraw hand-drawn style. Options are remembered per entity: calling `apply()` again only changes what you pass.

public static zigzagPathData(polygons: Vec2[][], gap: number, angle: number): string

Builds a continuous zigzag fill path across the polygons. Extracts interior intervals per scanline from `segments()`, chains overlapping intervals into continuous ribbons per branch/lobe, and traverses back-and-forth with bevel turns and subtle hand-drawn S-curves. Correctly handles non-convex polygons (stars, U-shapes) without crossing notches or leaking outside. [Source line 390](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/style/excalidraw/HachureGenerator.ts#L390).
public static scribblePathData(polygons: Vec2[][], gap: number, angle: number): string

Builds a continuous serpentine marker scribble path (back-and-forth shading). Sweeps across each chord, connects to the next chord along the shape boundary, and sweeps back. [Source line 569](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/style/excalidraw/HachureGenerator.ts#L569).
